title: Offline/restart delivery hardening and duplicate notification storm prevention
lane_parent: Manager Merge28 + TZ-NEXT-011 Pass05 + Pass06 + Pass07 true deltas
changes: Added persistent company-scoped delivery replay guard with deterministic channel/surface/lifecycle fingerprinting.
Added delivery leases to block concurrent duplicate dispatch storms.
Successful delivery suppresses restart replay only inside a bounded replay window.
Failed deliveries use bounded exponential backoff and capped attempts; exhaustion requires review.
Restart recovery exposes candidates but never automatically dispatches or replays effects.
Distinct lifecycle states, surfaces and channels retain separate delivery identities.
Wired guard into existing local storage bootstrap message API; no UI/startup shell or Workforce lifecycle authority changed.
